resources.string: Sign in
Access to nearby devices
To find your bike, YABA needs access to “Nearby devices”. YABA does not evaluate your location.
Allow access
Access was denied. Please allow it in the app settings under “Permissions”.
Access was denied. Tap “Allow access” to ask again.
Find your bike
YABA is searching for your bike over Bluetooth. Please stay close and close the VanMoof app, because the bike accepts only one phone at a time.
Search now
YABA has received no answer from “%1$s” for more than 12\u00A0seconds. Please close the VanMoof app and wake the bike with the bell button.
The VanMoof app often holds the only Bluetooth connection of the bike in the background, because the bike accepts only one phone at a time.
First unlock
YABA has found your bike. Drag the slider to the end, and YABA unlocks the bike directly over Bluetooth.
VanMoof’s server answered with error\u00A0%2$d at %1$s. Tap “Try again” to repeat the request.
At %1$s, no answer came within 10\u00A0seconds. Tap “Try again” to repeat the request.
VanMoof’s server has not answered any request from this phone for %1$d\u00A0days.
SCAN
Step\u00A0%1$d of %2$d
Change key
The search has stopped. Please stay close and close the VanMoof app, then search again.
